we have found no evidence for a population change of the X-ray sources from the RDS to the UDS.

the X-ray background can be explained with a simple population of AGNs with a luminosity function that is consistent with the observed luminosity functions of the bright AGN population, and with the fainter X-ray sources found in the RDS.
